name: Investigative Documentary
description: Pen-on-paper archival journalism aesthetic reminiscent of Vox, Johnny Harris, and Polymatter. Features warm ivory paper textures, traditional batik linework, notary stamps, amber highlighters, and financial evidence charts.
aiImagePromptPrefix: Archival dark slate documentary aesthetic (#111315), parchment textures (#ece6d8), forensic amber (#d97724) and crimson (#c93b2b) evidence stamps, gritty investigative journalism, high contrast:

character.treatment: Monochrome archival silhouette or authentic photographic cutout with borderless drop shadow
character.role: Historical figure or observer in context, never talking-head narrator

antiSlopRules: Strictly zero throat-clearing ('di era serba cepat', 'menyelami lebih dalam', 'tak dapat dipungkiri')
Ground every claim in balance sheets, court rulings, or chronological dates
Wrap proper acronyms in phonetic syntax: [BEI|B-E-I], [BBM|B-B-M], [SCBD|S-C-B-D]

stylingTips.pacing: Target 130–140 WPM. Scene beats should average 8–11 seconds. Subtitle chunks strictly 3–6 words without dangling prepositions.
stylingTips.exhibits: Prioritize authentic evidence: court filings, leaked memos, company financial reports, and archival press photography. Use 'torn-paper' framing for legal documents and 'polaroid' for field photos.
stylingTips.annotations: Use 'rubber-stamp' (e.g. TERVERIFIKASI, RAHASIA, DISAHKAN) for institutional rulings. Use 'highlighter' (amber/yellow) to isolate incriminating clauses.
stylingTips.dataGraphics: For figures > Rp 1 Miliar, use 'odometer-ticker' with dynamic count-up. Use TradingView-style 'line-chart' for multi-year stock crashes or debt trajectories.
stylingTips.antiSlopRules: Never use AI filler phrases ('di era digital', 'menyelami', 'tak dapat dipungkiri'). Ground every claim in causal mechanics, balance sheets, and verifiable dates.
